spans.s: 2. प mf(पा and पी)n. (√ 1. पा) drinking (cf. अंह्रि-, अनेक- &c.; also पक in तैल-पक)
f. the act of drinking, L.
3. प mfn. (√ 3. पा) guarding, protecting, ruling (ifc.; cf. अज-, कुल- &c.; also पक in हस्ति-पक)
4. प m. (in music for पञ्चम) the fifth note of the gamut.

etym.s: [cf. Gk. πέ-πω-κα; Aeol. πώ-νω = πίνω; Lat. pō-tus, pō-tum, bibo for pi-bo; Slav. pi-ja, pi-ti]

spans.s: 2. पा mfn. drinking, quaffing &c. (cf. अग्रे-, ऋतु-, मधु-, सोम- &c.)

etym.s: [cf. Zd. pā, paiti; Gk. πά-ομαι, πέ-πα-μαι, πῶ-ν, &c.; Lat. pa-sco, pa-bulum; Lith. pë-mů́]

spans.s: 4. पा mfn. keeping, protecting, guarding &c. (cf. अपान-, रिता-, गो-, तनू- &c.)
5. पा cl. 3. Ā. पि॑पीते, to rise against, be hostile (see 2. अनूत्-√ 5. पा, p. 41; 2. उत्-पा, p. 181; प्रत्य्-उत्- √ 5. पा, p. 677).
